chronicle.text: Ludol came back for food left 6 weeks before, and it was still there.
Teihei tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Tairo tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Heibeim gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Ruleidon went back to what they had left in one spot a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Shokoum drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Thaiba tied flint and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Heibeim scratched a mark </^.> into rock.
Ludol set food aside on purpose, having found it there when it was needed before: the beginning of keeping stores.
Heibeim buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
Teihei struck stone with flint and stared at what happened.
Heibeim struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
At (25, 14) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Kaivail had put in the most.
Tairo struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
Ronemai tied a club and a club together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
3 people now take the mark <v|/> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Thaiba tied a club and a blade together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
4 people now take the mark </^-> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Buthein took in the orphan Vougou, no relation, the first time a stranger raised another's child.
Roukarail attacked Kaileir: the first violence.
A hungry year: 3 people starved after a poor growing season.
Lukuzei found that what Roukarail had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
5 people now take the mark <.^-> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.

Kaileir killed Ludol after being attacked by Ludol in year 20.
Revenge answered revenge: the feud between the kin of Kaileir and the kin of Ludol had begun.
4 people now take the mark <o|o> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
